confidence_notes: Restaurant, coffee, and beer anchors use October 2026 Prague cost-of-living data. The cocktail estimate follows a recent downtown-club listing; a typical restaurant wine-glass price was not directly listed, so it is estimated from the local beer and mid-range wine price relationship. Accommodation prices are general estimates and vary substantially by season and location.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable-city adjustment used; food and drink estimates are based on Prague-specific reported prices, while accommodation anchors use general knowledge of Prague's tourism market.
